<jats:title>A<jats:sc>bstract</jats:sc>
                     </jats:title><jats:p>A novel approach to study the properties of models with quantum-deformed relativistic symmetries relies on a noncommutative space of worldlines rather than the usual noncommutative spacetime. In this setting, spacetime can be reconstructed as the set of events, that are identified as the crossing of different worldlines. We lay down the basis for this construction for the <jats:italic>κ</jats:italic>-Poincaré model, analyzing the fuzzy properties of <jats:italic>κ</jats:italic>-deformed time-like worldlines and the resulting fuzziness of the reconstructed events.</jats:p>
title: Fuzzy worldlines with κ-Poincaré symmetries
